title: Performance verification
summary: Records reproducible bundle, browser startup, and native scan_vault measurements comparing v0.4.45 (252b65a) against v0.4.46 (976fa63) for issue #201.
notes: No frontmatter, no filename/path type convention (plain docs/). Content is a measurement record: environment, method, result tables, explicit non-claims, and a verification checklist. No Decision/Consequences pair, no user stories or acceptance criteria, no API/schema/protocol contracts -> DOC rather than ADR/PRD/SPEC. Budget numbers (JS 320 KiB gzip, CSS 70 KiB) appear as observed gate values, not as prescribed constraints, so no SPEC signal. cross_refs empty: the doc references scripts and test files (perf-startup-profile.mjs, check-bundle-budget.mjs, vault.rs, smoke.spec.ts, startup.spec.ts, graph-shell.spec.ts) but no other documents and contains no markdown links. Filename suffix uses the parent directory ('docs') instead of a SHA-256 prefix: no shell tool was available in this agent to compute the hash; basename+parent is collision-free for this run.
